newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ's Peters outlines new employment policy.
newsitem.headline: NZ's Peters outlines new employment policy.

text.p: New Zealand Treasurer Winston Peters said on Wednesday the government aimed to reduce the duration of unemployment and ensure suitable community work and training for jobless people.
Peters said in a speech in Tauranga that work was under way to bring all government agencies involved in employment under one roof to establish a "one-stop shop".
Resources to assist the unemployed into work would move from central to regional control.
From April 1, beneficiaries who turned down suitable jobs or failed to turn up for job interviews would have their benefits reduced.
"We will do the best we can to help the unemployed, but equally, we expect them to help themselves. The days of sitting on the beach drawing the dole are over," Peters said.
